measurement_boundary: Model construction, training and per-epoch validation inside the context, including checkpoint saving; excludes feature extraction, dataset download and final test evaluation (separate evaluation record). CodeCarbon machine mode measures the whole computer, so the idle desktop, display output and any other open programs (e.g. TensorBoard, browser) are included; see the idle-baseline run for this fixed background draw.
reuse_notes: Frozen ResNet18 image features reused from the cache; no repeated image decoding or ResNet18 inference.
notes: Copy with scripts.run_logger.new_run_config for EACH run. F1 values use the 0-1 scale.
